$comment: Story 4.6 (ADR-158): HOLD — Suresh's way; back to the glass house. Suresh stays at the gate with the generator so the rest get in.

panels.title: THE PURPLE LINE · 03:30
panels.text: Back the way you came. Nobody says it was for nothing.

panels.title: LALBAGH · 05:10
panels.text: Something followed you out of the tunnel. Suresh hears it first.

panels.title: THE GATE
panels.text: 'Go in. Somebody has to keep it running.' He sits by the generator with the shutter between you. He doesn't come in.

panels.title: SIX MONTHS LATER
panels.text: Orchids under purple lamps. Uncle makes coffee at six. The city outside is quiet in a way that isn't peace.
